description: Set (add or change) or remove one spend limit of the connected project's workspace: a monthly or daily USD cap on the whole wallet (account), one team member, one API key (project), one way in (surface) or one agent. A limit counts the whole period in UTC, also what was spent before it was set, and once it is reached new work it covers is refused with error code 93. Each target can have one monthly and one daily limit. Only the account owner, a team admin or the organization's owner can change limits; for anyone else this changes nothing. Without `confirm: true` it returns a change summary: what the limit covers, its value before and after, what was spent this period and when it resets. Show it, wait for a clear yes, then repeat the call exactly as its nextAction shows. If the limit changed in between, or the call asks for anything else, nothing is saved and a new summary comes back. To change only the alert, give limit_guid and alert_percent.

action.description: set adds a limit, or changes the one with the same scope, target and period; remove deletes one.

agent.description: Scope agent: the deployed agent, by name or guid.

alert_percent.description: set: when the alert email goes out, at 50, 80 or 90 percent of the limit; null for no alert. Left out, a limit keeps its alert, and a new one gets 80.

amount_usd.description: set: the limit in USD, at least 0.01, rounded to cents. Left out with alert_percent, a limit keeps its amount.

confirm.description: Set true only by repeating the change summary's nextAction, after the user approved that summary.

limit_guid.description: The limit's guid from get_controls, in place of scope, its target and period.

member.description: Scope member, teams only: the member, by e-mail or user id.

period.description: month (from the 1st, 00:00 UTC) or day (from 00:00 UTC). Left out, the period of the target's only limit, and month for a new one.

project.description: Scope project: the API key's project, by id or exact name. Left out, this connection's own key.

scope.description: What the limit caps: account (the whole wallet), member (one team member), project (one API key), surface (one way in) or agent (one deployed agent). Needed unless limit_guid names the limit.

summary_id.description: From the change summary's nextAction: the id of the change the user saw. Never set it yourself.

surface.description: Scope surface: web (the dashboard), api (an API key, a local install of this server included), mcp (the hosted MCP server), llm-gateway, extension or agent.

updated_at.description: From the change summary's nextAction: the version of the limit the user saw. Never set it yourself.
